text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Doo-n-teke tsuku-tsuku-tsuku-tsuku... 
Ta-dah! Your birthday present is~~~~ M-E☆

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What gives! When I asked what you wanted 
the other day, that's what you said, 
Don-chan!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Hoh... Quite an eccentric thing to say, 
Gentil.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I haven't the slightest recollection of 
that. Would you kindly stop making false 
accusations?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, you did say it, didn't you? 'A 
training partner who won't break even if I 
go all out.'

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that—yes, I certainly did say that. 
Hohoho... But are you sure? Are you truly 
prepared to take on everything I have?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The Unsinkable Ship never goes back on her 
word!! Alrighty then!! Come on, bring it, 
big catches, carps and all!!!! Act now and 
you'll get an Orfevre bundled right in, 
what a bargain!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
My apologies, Gentildonna. It seems 
Orfevre is not-not-not-not-not quite able 
to keep up with this battle—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—Heh. I did not say I wouldn't. Consider 
it a royal bestowal; behold the robust 
vitality of a king.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Chuckle. Not a bad gift, considering who 
it's from.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If I happen to accidentally shatter it —do 
forgive me, won't you?
